messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference-prod · severity=critical · incident=INC-2026-8472 · reason=timeout+5xx spike >5% in 1m. Paging on-call: @Carla Rivera. Link: https://pagerduty.redwood.example/INC-2026-8472 :rotating_light:
Carla Rivera: Acked in PD, I'm on it. Jumping into metrics and tracing now.
incident-bot: PD Ack recorded (Carla Rivera). Secondary escalation will occur in 5m if not acknowledged.
Carla Rivera: quick snapshot — huge p95/p99 tail in eu-west1 for model redwood-8b-quant, node pool inference-pool-3 GPU util ~98%, pod restarts 3x in last 2m. No config deploy in last 30m from git, but there was a canary earlier today.
Riley Zhou: I didn't get the page (mobile DND?). PD shows primary ack, secondary still unacked. If Carla needs handoff, I can join in 2m.
Carla Rivera: @Riley no handoff yet, I'm triaging. First check: pods, logs, and a quick route change if we need to take pressure off the 8b.
Carla Rivera: running:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference --sort-by=.status.startTime
kubectl logs -n inference pod/infer-redwood-8b-0 -c inference --tail=200
```
Samir Patel: seeing the same; kernel OOM events on infer hosts and some NVLink timeouts. Autoscaler didn't trigger extra nodes — looks like the ASG threshold for gpu_mem_free was too strict.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary unacknowledged after 5m. Manager escalation scheduled in 5m.
Carla Rivera: I'm going to route a fraction of traffic to redwood-4b-quant and reduce batch size on the 8b to reduce memory pressure. Doing a quick routing patch now.
Carla Rivera: patch applied to routing: `traffic_split: 8b=60%,4b=40%` — verifying.
deploy-bot: Routing change applied by Carla Rivera via infra-console — roll ID r-2026-ptx9.
Tom Anders: I'm awake, joining bridge. DM me the bridge link.
Carla Rivera: @Tom https://meet.redwood.example/bridge/INC-2026-8472 — added context in the PD incident.
Maya Lopez: CS report: 7 paid customers reported inference errors/timeouts in the last 8 minutes, mainly EU region. We flagged a severity-2 for outward-facing customer communications.
Samir Patel: temporary mitigation suggestion: lower continuous batching window and evict KV cache per-worker to avoid a growing memory footprint. Can push a hotfix hook.
Carla Rivera: pushing hotfix to the runtime to cap batch window to 32ms:
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{
  "batch_window_ms": 32
}
```
Rolling to 20% canaries first.
Riley Zhou: joining bridge now. I can help with node autoscaler override. If we force-add 2 nodes it's ~7m to provision but buys time.
Carla Rivera: please do the override, @Riley. Command:
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-eu-west1 --desired-capacity 6
```
Riley Zhou: done. ASG set to 6 -> provisioning. Notified infra team.
incident-bot: PagerDuty manager escalation triggered: Manager Tom Anders notified due to secondary and handoff delay.
Tom Anders: On the bridge, looking at logs. Any indication of a recent model rollout toggling larger max_seq?
Samir Patel: yes, the canary changed `max_context_tokens` for 8b from 2048 -> 4096 earlier today; memory blowup on a few hot requests. That's the likely culprit combined with narrow autoscaler thresholds.
Carla Rivera: rollback plan: revert max_context_tokens to 2048 for 8b canary and re-evaluate. Rolling revert now.
deploy-bot: Revert executed: service=inference, change=r-2026-revert-maxseq, started.
Maya Lopez: letting CS know we have an active mitigation (routing + autoscale + rollback) and ETA for full recovery ~10-15m. Customers asked for status page update.
Carla Rivera: updating status page: status.redwood.example -> "degraded_performance" for hosted-inference-prod in EU region.
Samir Patel: after the revert and batch window cap, memory pressure drops on hosts, pod restarts stop. Monitoring shows p99 latency dropping.
Riley Zhou: new nodes are in and pods are scheduling, but seems okay now even before full scale.
Carla Rivera: PD note: I acknowledged, initiated mitigations (routing patch, batch cap, autoscale override, rollback). Will watch for 10m.
Tom Anders: Good job. I'll stay on the bridge for handoff. @Carla please hand over to oncall when stable.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-2026-8472 status changed to acknowledged -> resolved at 1819991365 (trigger auto-resolve after no further alerts).
Carla Rivera: marking thread resolved here. Root cause: combined regression (canary change increased max_context_tokens) + autoscaler thresholds too conservative -> memory exhaustion and pod restarts -> increased timeouts. Action items: 1) tighten canary checks for token-length regressions, 2) adjust autoscaler metrics to include gpu_mem_free, 3) add PD suppression for short noisy bursts and reduce manager escalation timeout to avoid wakeups on transient blips, 4) postmortem scheduled.
Tom Anders: Adding followups: postmortem owner: Samir, timeline doc in confluence, customer comms draft by Maya.
Maya Lopez: CS will send impacted-customer note after PM review.
Carla Rivera: thanks all. Closing this thread once PM is filed. :white_check_mark:
